encounter: E0180 TRAINER_JOSUE (Route105, Feather Badge - optional Surf backtrack, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: Route 105 is reached by Surf after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json: New Mauville entrance and interior via Wattson's Basement Key (30), Sneasel (14), Thwackey line (36), Granite Cave Abra plus Slateport Linking Cord (20), Haunter plus Linking Cord (30). All precede the first Surf. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: Josue is four Flying-types behind Drizzle and Tailwind. Electric is 4x on Pelipper and Cramorant and Ice is 2x on all four, so Magnezone and Weavile are the two engines - and Magnezone matters twice over here, because Steel resists Flying, Ice and Rock and Josue's whole team carries no Ground, Fire or Fighting move to punish it. Rillaboom's Grass is the second answer to the two Water/Flying bodies and Grassy Glide is priority that a Tailwind cannot outrun. The two things to respect are Kilowattrel's Wind Power, which charges off Josue's own Hurricane and Tailwind and doubles his Electric damage, and Tornadus's Prankster Taunt and Tailwind; Gengar's own Taunt and Alakazam's speed are the answers to the second. Rain makes every Hurricane 100 percent accurate, so there is no missing-Hurricane luck to bank on.
